cross_references.relationship: PRIMARY_PREDICATE — §1343 listed in §1961(1)(B); each wire fraud act is a RICO predicate. Two or more §1343 acts that satisfy H.J. Inc. pattern test = RICO pattern.
PREDICATE — §1028 listed in §1961(1)(B) (added 2002). §1028 identity theft acts are RICO predicates alongside §1343 acts.
PREDICATE — §1028A listed in §1961(1)(B) (added 2004). Aggravated identity theft acts are RICO predicates.
PARALLEL_CIVIL — FCRA provides the civil remedy for ChexSystems and credit reporting fraud. RICO provides treble damages for the same actors' pattern across multiple schemes. Plead both.
